description: Sign in with the kernel's API token and open an authenticated dashboard shell

actions.comment: Two stale assumptions fixed here. (1) This module used to wait on #app-ready — an element that appears nowhere in the dashboard source or build, and `git log -S` shows it never did; every test using the module therefore sat here for its full timeout regardless of what the app did. It now delegates to goto-view, which waits on `.sidebar`, an element the layout actually renders, and keeps the login + onboarding seeding in one place. (2) It used to land on `/`, back when `/` was the dashboard home. `/` now just redirects to /agents-flow — the 3D office, the single heaviest page in the app — which is a slow and misleading proxy for 'the dashboard is up'. Callers of this module only need an authenticated shell, so it lands on /sysoverview: a core route (always allowed by the manifest guard, no extension dependency) that renders the same shell in a fraction of the time. Tests that specifically want the home view or the 3D office should $use goto-view with that path instead.
